 Published on : 27-05-2026 01:53 pm 
 NAGALAND PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION 
 NAGALAND: KOHIMA 
 No. NPSC/EXAM-21 /2023 Dated
Kohima, the 27 th May,2026 
 Normal

 Corrigendum 
 In continuation to the Advertisement No. NPSC-1/CESE-2026
dated 29.04.2026 and Addendum/Corrigendum dated 12.05.2026, the following
corrigendum and clarification regarding subject eligibility and related matters
is shown as under: 
 Normal 
 0 
 false 
 false 
 false 
 EN-US 
 X-NONE 
 X-NONE 
 1. 
 As
per the letter from Directorate of Higher Education vide No.
HED/GE/Post-Advt (pt-1)/2021/101 dated
22 nd May, 2026, in supersession to the Addendum/Corrigendum dated 11 th 
May 2026, Point No.2 the preference column shall be omitted keeping in line
with NHESR 2015. The final recommendation will be entirely on merit basis, except
 1 (one) post of Linguistics under Item No.2 and backlog
vacancies. 
 2. 
 For
the post of Asst. Professor/PGT (Geography), a candidate with Masters of
Science in Geography and Resource Management is eligible to apply. 
 3. 
 For
the posts of Asst.Professor (Geology), a candidate with Masters of Science in
Applied Geology & Ph.D in applied Geology is eligible to apply. 
 4. 
 For
the Post of Asst. Professor (Chemistry), candidate with Masters in Bio-Chemistry
is NOT eligible . 
 5. 
 For
the Post of Asst.Professor (Botany), a candidate with Masters in Bio-chemistry
and Molecular Biology is NOT eligible . 
 6. For Asst.Professor (Environmental Science) candidate
with Ph.D in Bio-Chemistry is NOT
eligible. Required Qualification is Master in Environmental Science with
NET or Ph.D in Environmental Science. 
 7. 
 For the Post of Asst. Professor (Physical
Science) under College Teachers Education (CTE), NET or PhD in Education is mandatory . As such, candidates
with NET in Physics/Chemistry but without
NET/Ph.D in Education are henceforth NOT
eligible as per NCTE Norms and regulations. (Those candidates who have applied for Item No. 19 only without NET or PhD in Education may claim for refund by
submitting an application to the Secretary NPSC ) 
 8. 
 The
2 (Two) posts of Asst. Professor (Commerce) notified in Addendum dated 18 th 
May 2026 may be read as reserved for Indigenous Inhabitants of Nagaland (I.I)
and not as rendered. 
 9. 
 Other
Terms and Conditions remain the same. 
 Sd/- (NUNGSANGMENLA IMCHEN) 
Secretary, 
Nagaland Public Service Commission, 
Kohima
